description: Find the HS/commodity code and import duty for goods shipped into the UK or the US. Looks up a code or keyword: UK Global Tariff third-country duty, preferential rates by origin where given, VAT and measure types from the UK Trade Tariff, and US HTS general, special and column-2 rates from USITC. Keyword search returns candidate codes; final classification stays with the importer. Use when quoting landed cost or preparing a UK or US customs entry. $0.004 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

origin.description: Optional ISO2 origin country for UK preferential rates

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

query.description: Keyword search instead of a code, e.g. laptop

name: hs_tariff
